legal.privacy1: We collect what is needed to teach you and to prove what you learned: your name, college, roll number, lessons, answers and results.
legal.privacy2: Employers never see your name, contact details or lesson history unless you say yes to that employer, item by item. You can withdraw at any time.
legal.privacy3: Your college sees your progress. Your parents see a progress report only if you agree.
legal.privacy4: You can download everything we hold about you from Settings, and ask for it to be deleted.
legal.terms1: Use Qubirex for learning, teaching, verifying and hiring as described on this site.
legal.terms2: Do not share your PIN or let someone else answer checks for you; Passports record how sure we are that you did the work.
legal.terms3: Employers may request a learner’s evidence only for a real role and only after their company is verified.
legal.dpdp1: Consent is asked for each purpose separately, in your language, and can be withdrawn as easily as it was given.
legal.dpdp2: For learners under 18, a parent or guardian’s consent is collected through the institution before anything is shared with employers.
legal.dpdp3: You have the right to access, correct and erase your data, and to name someone to act for you.
legal.grievance2: Email: {email}. We acknowledge within 7 days and resolve within 30 days.
legal.grievance3: Signed-in users can also use Help → Contact and choose “Complaint”.
legal.note: Plain-words summary. The full legal text in Telugu, Hindi and English is being finalised.

demo.noVoice: This browser has no voice for this language, so the lesson is shown as text. Try Chrome on Android for spoken Telugu and Hindi.
demo.noSpeech: This browser cannot speak aloud, so the lesson is shown as text.
demo.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser’s address bar, or type your answer below.
demo.micNone: Voice input does not work in this browser. Please type your answer below.
demo.micRetry: We could not hear that. Try again, or type your answer.
demo.l.lesson: A JOIN puts two tables together where a value matches — like pairing students in two lists who share the same roll number.
demo.l.question: Which rows does an INNER JOIN keep?
demo.l.correct: Yes! An INNER JOIN keeps only the rows that match in both tables. SQL joins is now on your Passport.
demo.l.hint: Close. Think about the roll numbers: which students appear in both lists? Try again.
demo.l.heardAudio: Thanks, I recorded your answer. In the full app I listen to it and reply; in this demo, here is the answer: an INNER JOIN keeps only the rows that match in both tables.
demo.l.passportNote: Each skill is proven on fresh questions and signed. Nothing here is saved.
demo.c.nearly: {n} nearly ready — most need SQL aggregation.
demo.c.retest: Re-test the skill on the due date
demo.c.saved: Demo only, nothing is saved. Your programme is added to the list below for this visit.
demo.e.asked: Asked — the student decides what to share

verify.title: Verify a Capability Passport
verify.sub: Enter the Evidence ID the holder gave you. You will see whether the Passport is genuine, and the skill details if the holder chose to share them.
verify.cameraView: Camera view for scanning the QR code
verify.pointCamera: Point the camera at the Passport QR code. It stops by itself once it reads the code.
verify.cameraDenied: Camera permission was not given. Type the Evidence ID above instead.
verify.noCamera: No camera was found on this device. Type the Evidence ID above instead.
verify.cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot use the camera here. Type the Evidence ID above, or open the QR with your phone’s camera app.
verify.st.malformed: That is not a valid Evidence ID
verify.st.malformed.d: Check for a typo. IDs look like QBX- followed by 12 letters and digits.
verify.st.not_found.d: Check the ID with the person who shared it.
verify.st.expired.d: Ask the holder for a renewed Passport.
verify.st.signature_invalid: The signature does not check out
verify.st.signature_invalid.d: This record cannot be trusted. It may have been changed, or its key was withdrawn.
verify.st.rate_limited: Too many checks from this network
verify.st.rate_limited.d: Please try again in an hour.
verify.st.offline.d: Check your connection and try again.
verify.authenticNote: The issuer’s signature matches its published keys and the Passport has not been revoked. The skill lines below say how strongly each skill was checked (L) and how sure Qubirex is that the learner gave the answers (A).
verify.private: The holder has not made skill details public. Ask them to share them with you.
verify.sampleNote: This is a sample Passport with made-up data, for the demo. Try the name check with “Lakshmi Rao”.
verify.labelsNote: Labels are worked out today by the published label rule ({fn}) from signed, dated facts — the same Passport shows a lower label if a skill has not been shown again recently.
verify.nameTitle: Is this the person in front of you?
verify.nameNote: Initials and surname order are handled. The stored name is never shown.
verify.limitsTitle: What this check can and can’t tell you
verify.can1: The record is genuine, signed by Qubirex and not revoked.
verify.can2: How each skill was proven and how sure we are the learner did the work.
verify.can3: Whether a name you type matches the holder.
verify.cannot1: How the person will perform in your team, or their attitude and fit.
verify.cannot2: Skills the learner chose not to share publicly.
verify.cannot3: The holder’s name, phone, college roll or lesson history.
